newsitem.title: USA: Duane Reade Holding says DLJ to be majority holder.
newsitem.headline: Duane Reade Holding says DLJ to be majority holder.

text.p: Duane Reade Holding Corp said Friday that its shareholder group, which includes Bain Capital and management, will be joined by Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette affiliate DLJ Merchant Banking Partners II, which will become the majority shareholder in the company.
The transaction, which is estimated to have a value of about $350 million, will be treated as a recapitalization for accounting purposes, the company said.
Duane Reade is the largest drug store chain in Manhattan with more than 60 stores and sales in 1996 of about $383 million.
